system.description:
You release a collection of thrown weapons that cover a wide range piercing through everything and one in their path. Creature in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapon Damage] + 1d12 on a failed save or half as on a success.

Chain 1: Creatures who fail their saving throw are knocked prone and are disarmed of any item they are holding.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d12.
